rules.statement: AHB master and AXI Subordinate BFMs shall be independent of each other.

rules.condition: When computing expected transactions in verification
rules.statement: Expected transactions shall be computed from accepted AHB pin activity and stated mappings, not from RTL hierarchy, internal state or generated names.
All test sources and run commands shall be retained in the verification deliverable.
The verification flow owner shall place all run commands in one Makefile.

rules.condition: During AXI READY stalls and delayed or missing R/B responses (TEST-07)
rules.statement: AXI VALID and payload shall remain stable during READY stalls; no completion bound is asserted and the bridge has no internal timeout.
Protocol checks shall report no violation on legal traffic and shall report injected endpoint violations.
AXI VALID and payload must remain stable while READY=0.

rules.condition: Before AHB acceptance of the read
rules.statement: No AXI read may be issued before AHB acceptance.
ARLEN must be 0 for single-beat reads.
WLAST must be asserted at exactly the final W beat.

rules.condition: Before complete aggregated AHB burst is captured
rules.statement: No AW may be issued before the complete aggregated AHB burst is captured.
AHB responses must be returned in order.
AHB ERROR response must last two cycles.
ID values must remain below the configured ID count.

Functional coverage shall cross direction, size, burst type, HPROT memory type, bufferable/non-bufferable, strobe mask, response status, READY stall length, uniform/varying address attributes, early termination, ID count and reset timing.
Formal checks shall prove ordering, no duplication/loss, no speculative read, no AXI boundary crossing and response mapping.
Static timing analysis shall treat all bridge and FIFO paths as single-clock synchronous paths under i_clk_core, with no CDC paths or asynchronous clock groups.
Reset analysis shall verify the one-reset contract, asynchronous assertion, SoC-synchronized deassertion before the IP boundary, and clearing of FIFO valid state.
